scope: Static QC comparison; hardware observations are inherited from TEST-PROTOCOL.md and are not re-verified.

controls.control: Zephyr application structure and build inputs
controls.evidence: CMakeLists.txt, prj.conf, board overlay and src/main.c are present.
controls.required_action: Pin the Zephyr manifest revision; retain a clean-build result as an artifact.

controls.evidence: GPIO, ADC, PWM, SPI, display, touch and I2S routing are represented in the board overlay.
controls.required_action: Validate the documented unverified I2S/LEDC pinmux and XPT2046 calibration on hardware.

controls.evidence: Target has 12 C source file(s); main.c has 257 lines. THA reference splits ADC, sensor, servo, stepper, display and shell modules.
controls.required_action: Split peripheral probes/drivers, audio pipeline, UI/input and status reporting into owned modules.
Pass touch events through k_msgq/k_event or protect all callback/thread shared state atomically.

controls.evidence: The button and SP3T are polled in a 20 ms loop; touch is interrupt/callback driven. THA latency study identifies ISR + deferred processing as the deterministic pattern.
controls.required_action: Use GPIO interrupts for user inputs when a response-time requirement is introduced; document the current <=20 ms polling bound.

controls.evidence: Heuristic found 0 driver/API calls used as statements or explicitly discarded; several runtime output paths cannot report failure.
controls.required_action: Check and log display_write, PWM, I2S write/trigger and GPIO set failures; define recovery behavior.

controls.evidence: Per-component retry/probe table isolates missing peripherals; audio starts only when both endpoints pass.
controls.required_action: Distinguish on-chip controller readiness from physical-device presence in machine-readable results.

controls.evidence: Structured Zephyr logging and periodic counters exist, but stack/thread analyzer protection is not enabled.
controls.required_action: Enable stack protection/thread analyzer in a QC configuration and capture high-water marks under audio/display load.

controls.evidence: Detailed manual release protocol exists; automated Zephyr tests=True; recorded hardware verdicts=11. Hardware verdicts are not inferred from simulation.
controls.required_action: Before release, record machine-readable physical-hardware verdicts keyed by firmware commit.

controls.evidence: Pinned traceability manifest and all locally available baseline hashes match.
